Subject: Re: Planning: fall renewals (Greenhouse + Checkr) and LMS pilot

Laura / Monica — thanks for the materials. Quick proposal for our internal recommendation deck:

Option A — Renew both as-is with 24-month discounts (lowest near-term operational risk)
- Greenhouse: accept 12% multi-year price; waive onboarding
- Checkr: accept stepped pricing; request Trial SLA for first 90 days

Option B — Consolidate parts of workflow + pilot LMS
- Move manager-facing onboarding modules into LumenLMS pilot (cost: pilot $12k, migration effort 3 weeks)
- Negotiate with Greenhouse to remove the Offer Engine addon if LMS covers offer training (saves ~8% ARR)
- Consolidate background verification: keep Checkr for criminal/device checks; evaluate built-in ID verification from partner vendors

Can everyone add estimated migration effort (hrs) and a quick risk note by EOD Wednesday (9/9)? I’ll compile into a short deck for procurement and TA leadership.

Thanks,
Naomi
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, vendor-contracts@vendorlegal.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: fall renewals (Greenhouse + Checkr) and LMS pilot

Naomi — we reviewed with TA leadership this afternoon. Decision: go with Option A for speed to market but ask vendors for the following concessions before signature:

- Greenhouse: lock 24-month term at 12% off AND confirm SSO/SCIM windows for November rollout; request a clause for partial refund if uptime SLA < 99.5% in first quarter.
- Checkr: accept stepped pricing but require data-retention clause aligned with Redwood policy and 30-day dispute resolution on results.
- LumenLMS: run a 6-week pilot focused on manager onboarding; pilot budget approved ($12k).

Next steps: Monica — please set up contract redline session with vendor-contracts and schedule a 30-min term-negotiation call with Greenhouse/Javier for 9/21. Marcus — coordinate Checkr legal redline with vendor-contracts.

Laura Bennett
VP, Talent Acquisition
